concepts.gloss_en: The rectification (tikkun) of the imaginative faculty (koach ha-medameh)

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are in the same lesson (lm2:8) and refer to the identical idea — rectifying the imaginative faculty. 'המדמה' and 'כח המדמה' are just the short and full names for the same koach ha-medameh; the paragraphs confirm both discuss tikkun of sleep/imagination. Clean merge, no homograph risk.
